doc-001: The city council met on Tuesday to discuss the proposed cycle lane on Market Street.
Local shop owners argued the lane would remove 40 parking spaces and hurt trade.
Cycling groups pointed to a 25% rise in commuter cycling over the past two years.
The council voted 7 to 4 to approve a six-month trial starting in March.

doc-003: The study followed 1,200 adults over five years to examine the effect of daily walking on blood pressure.
Participants who walked at least 30 minutes a day had an average systolic reduction of 6 mmHg.
The effect was strongest in participants over 60.
The authors note that the study was observational and cannot establish causation.
